cases.name: Noreen B. Schmid Boyle
cases.narrative:
On 1/25/1989, her body was found buried her underneath his basement floor in the house he shared with his pregnant girlfriend. He bought green indoor/outdoor carpet and shelves to conceal the spot. She was found with a plastic bag tied over her head and also had blunt force trauma to the head. She was hit at least twice in the head with what appeared to be a hammer. Her body had multiple contusions and she was in a state of moderate decomposition.

"He was such a control freak," the late Richland County Prosecutor James Mayer Jr. said for a 2010 News Journal story. "He wanted the body right underneath his feet. That was the type of guy he was. He was diabolical."

https://www.mansfieldnewsjournal.com/story/news/local/2014/12/30/dr-john-boyle-murder-case-years-later/21068335/
